description: Source code implementing asynchronous disk cache file I/O operations, including classes for background IO and in-flight IO management, with methods for reading, writing, and managing file length.

classes.name: FileBackgroundIO
classes.description: Represents a single asynchronous IO operation, handling read/write tasks in background threads.

classes.name: FileInFlightIO
classes.description: Manages current asynchronous IO operations, posting read/write tasks and handling their completion.

methods.name: File::Init
methods.description: Initializes the file object with a given filename.

methods.name: File::IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the file object is valid.

methods.name: File::Read
methods.description: Performs a synchronous read from the file.

methods.name: File::Write
methods.description: Performs a synchronous write to the file.

methods.name: File::Read (overloaded)
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous read with callback.

methods.name: File::Write (overloaded)
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous write with callback.

methods.name: File::SetLength
methods.description: Sets the length of the file.

methods.name: File::GetLength
methods.description: Returns the length of the file.

methods.name: File::WaitForPendingIOForTesting
methods.description: Waits for all pending IO operations to complete (testing utility).

methods.name: File::DropPendingIO
methods.description: Drops all pending IO operations (testing utility).

methods.name: File::platform_file
methods.description: Returns the underlying platform file handle.
